verdict.rationale: Relay offers automation like real-time expense categorization and syncing to accounting software, plus automated approvals, which could contribute to faster book closing, but there is no evidence of any AI-specific automation features (e.g., AI reconciliation, anomaly detection) as the story specifies. Missing for 10: explicit AI-driven automation capabilities, evidence tying automation directly to faster month-end close, and independent confirmation of these accounting-sync features working in practice.
